[[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] '''Grimorgi Flayre''' was the head of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] following the [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. A mysterious figure, later revealed to be [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], assisted him in solving crimes.<ref name="Game" />
